per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ មុនដាំដំណាំ បងប្អូនតែងធ្វើពិធីសែនអ្នកតា ជាម្ចាស់ទឹកម្ចាស់ដី ដើម្បីសុំឲ្យជួយគាំពារ ឲ្យស្រែចម្ការបានល្អ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Trước khi gieo trồng, người dân thường làm lễ cầu khấn Neak Ta, vị thần cai quản đất đai, để xin phù hộ cho mùa màng bội thu.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content very well: before planting, the Khmer community performs a ritual/offering to Neak Ta, understood as a land-related tutelary spirit, to request protection/blessing for successful cultivation. The rendering 'ឲ្យស្រែចម្ការបានល្អ' accurately conveys the idea of favorable crops/fields. The phrase 'ជួយគាំពារ' corresponds well to Vietnamese 'phù hộ'. There is a minor expansion from 'vị thần đất đai' to 'ម្ចាស់ទឹកម្ចាស់ដី', but this is culturally appropriate and not a harmful distortion.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' for 'Người Khmer' and 'បងប្អូន' for 'bà con'. Both are pragmatically appropriate in Khmer/K Khmer Krom-style community discourse. 'បងប្អូន' is a natural kinship/community term for villagers or community members and does not breach social hierarchy. The reference uses 'ប្រជាជន', but the hypothesis's choice is socially and contextually acceptable.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted copied forms are present. Key vocabulary such as 'ពិធីសែនអ្នកតា', 'ម្ចាស់ទឹកម្ចាស់ដី', 'ជួយគាំពារ', and 'ស្រែចម្ការ' are legitimate Khmer expressions. 'អ្នកតា' is correctly rendered as an authentic cultural-religious term rather than a raw transliteration.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has natural Khmer word order and fluent phrase structure: temporal phrase first, subject/community term, habitual action, ritual object, appositional explanation, and purpose clause. The flow is idiomatic and arguably more natural than a literal rendering. Modifier and clause sequencing are well formed.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that fully preserves the source meaning while using culturally appropriate Khmer vocabulary. The localized expression 'ម្ចាស់ទឹកម្ចាស់ដី' is especially suitable for Neak Ta-related religious practice and should not be penalized. The translation is semantically faithful, pragmatically appropriate, syntactically fluent, and lexically legitimate.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Lễ cúng này thường diễn ra như thế nào và có sự tham gia của cả cộng đồng hay chỉ gia đình riêng lẻ?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: ពិធី​បន់ស្រន់​នេះ​តែងតែ​ប្រព្រឹត្ត​ទៅ​យ៉ាង​ដូចម្តេច ហើយ​មាន​ការ​ចូលរួម​ពី​សហគមន៍​ទាំងមូល ឬ​គ្រាន់តែ​គ្រួសារ​ឯកជន?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសួរ៖ ពិធីសែននេះ តាមធម្មតាគេធ្វើឡើងយ៉ាងម៉េច ហើយមានស្រុកភូមិទាំងមូលចូលរួម ឬគ្រាន់តែគ្រួសាររៀងៗខ្លួន?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Nghi lễ cầu nguyện này thường được tiến hành như thế nào, và có sự tham gia của cả cộng đồng hay chỉ trong phạm vi gia đình riêng?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content of the source and reference: the interviewer asks how the ritual/ceremony usually takes place and whether participation involves the broader community or only individual families. The rendering “ពិធីសែននេះ” accurately conveys a worship/offering ceremony in a culturally appropriate way, though it is somewhat more specific than the reference “ពិធី​បន់ស្រន់.” “ស្រុកភូមិទាំងមូល” conveys the local village/community as a whole and is semantically close to “សហគមន៍​ទាំងមូល,” though slightly more localized. No major omission or distortion is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “អ្នកសួរ” for “Người phỏng vấn,” which is acceptable though slightly less formal/specific than “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍.” The impersonal subject “គេ” in “គេធ្វើឡើង” is natural Khmer usage for general habitual actions. There are no inappropriate pronouns, kinship terms, or violations of religious/social hierarchy.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis contains authentic Khmer vocabulary and localized expressions: “ពិធីសែន,” “តាមធម្មតា,” “ស្រុកភូមិ,” and “គ្រួសាររៀងៗខ្លួន” are legitimate lexical choices. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese or corrupted character-copying. The wording is culturally and regionally plausible.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically fluent and natural in Khmer. The word order is idiomatic: topic phrase followed by habitual construction, then a coordinated participation question. “ហើយមានស្រុកភូមិទាំងមូលចូលរួម ឬ...” flows naturally, though the overall register is slightly more conversational than the human reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that fully preserves the communicative intent and almost all semantic details. Minor differences include the less formal “អ្នកសួរ” instead of “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍,” “ពិធីសែន” instead of the reference’s broader “ពិធីបន់ស្រន់,” and “ស្រុកភូមិ” instead of the more abstract “សហគមន៍.” These are not serious errors and are acceptable within Khmer/K Khmer Krom cultural usage. The translation is fluent, natural, and lexically legitimate.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Thường cả phum sóc cùng tụ tập, dâng lễ vật đơn giản như gạo, trầu cau, nhang đèn, thể hiện lòng thành kính với Neak Ta.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: ជាធម្មតា ភូមិទាំងមូលប្រមូលផ្តុំគ្នា ដោយថ្វាយគ្រឿងសក្ការៈសាមញ្ញៗដូចជា អង្ករ ស្លា​ម្លូ ធូប​ទៀន បង្ហាញ​ពី​ការ​គោរព​ដ៏​ស្មោះ​ចំពោះ​អ្នកតា។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ ជាធម្មតា អ្នកក្នុងភូមិស្រុកទាំងមូលមកជុំគ្នា យកគ្រឿងសក្ការៈសាមញ្ញៗ ដូចជា អង្ករ ម្លូស្លា ធូបទៀន មកថ្វាយ បង្ហាញចិត្តគោរពសក្ការៈដល់អ្នកតា។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Thông thường, cả làng cùng tụ họp, dâng những lễ vật giản dị như gạo, trầu cau, nhang đèn, thể hiện lòng thành kính đối với Ông Tà.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content: Khmer people/community members gather, bring simple offerings such as rice, betel-areca, incense and candles, and show reverence to Neak Ta. The rendering of 'cả phum sóc' as 'អ្នកក្នុងភូមិស្រុកទាំងមូល' is slightly broader than the reference's 'ភូមិទាំងមូល', but the intended communal gathering is still clearly preserved. No critical omission or distortion is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic personal pronouns. 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' is acceptable for 'Người Khmer', though slightly less formal than 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ' in the reference. The culturally significant term 'អ្នកតា' is correctly used and maintains the appropriate respect toward the tutelary/local spirit figure.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is authentic Khmer and culturally legitimate. Terms such as 'គ្រឿងសក្ការៈ', 'អង្ករ', 'ម្លូស្លា', 'ធូបទៀន', and 'អ្នកតា' are valid lexical choices. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or corrupted Vietnamese-to-Khmer character copying.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence flows naturally in Khmer. The construction 'យកគ្រឿងសក្ការៈ...មកថ្វាយ' is idiomatic and clear. Minor differences from the reference, such as the expanded phrasing 'អ្នកក្នុងភូមិស្រុកទាំងមូល', do not significantly harm readability or grammaticality.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is high quality and culturally appropriate. It accurately conveys the source meaning, uses legitimate Khmer religious and cultural vocabulary, and maintains respectful reference to Neak Ta. Minor phrasing differences and a slightly broader rendering of the community setting prevent a perfect semantic/morpho-syntactic match, but the translation remains fully understandable and contextually sound.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Ngoài cúng Neak Ta, tôi nghe nói còn có lễ xuống đồng, anh có thể giải thích thêm ý nghĩa phong tục này?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: ក្រៅ​ពី​ការ​បន់ស្រន់​អ្នកតា ខ្ញុំ​លឺ​ថា​មាន​ពិធី​ ចុះ​ស្រែ តើ​បង​អាច​ពន្យល់​បន្ថែម​ពី​អត្ថន័យ​នៃ​ទំនៀមទម្លាប់​នេះ​បានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ ក្រៅពីសែនអ្នកតា ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយថា នៅមានពិធីចុះស្រែផង បងអាចពន្យល់បន្ថែមពីអត្ថន័យទំនៀមទម្លាប់នេះបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Ngoài việc cầu khấn ông Tà, tôi nghe nói còn có nghi lễ xuống đồng. Anh có thể giải thích thêm về ý nghĩa của phong tục này không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the full informational content of the source and the human reference: the interviewer asks about a custom beyond worship/offering to Neak Ta, mentions having heard that there is also a 'ចុះស្រែ' ceremony, and asks the addressee to explain its meaning. The phrase 'ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយថា' is a natural rendering of 'tôi nghe nói' and does not distort the meaning. 'សែនអ្នកតា' accurately conveys 'cúng Neak Ta' in a culturally appropriate way.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses 'អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍' for the interviewer and 'បង' for the addressed person, matching the human reference and maintaining the appropriate Khmer/K Khmer Krom pragmatic relationship. The first-person pronoun 'ខ្ញុំ' is also appropriate. No honorific or kinship misuse is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All key lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions. 'សែនអ្នកតា' is an authentic culturally grounded expression for making offerings to Neak Ta and should not be penalized. 'ពិធីចុះស្រែ', 'ពន្យល់', 'អត្ថន័យ', and 'ទំនៀមទម្លាប់' are all valid Khmer terms. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or corrupted character-copying.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is fluent and natural in Khmer. Word order is idiomatic: 'ក្រៅពីសែនអ្នកតា', 'ខ្ញុំឮគេនិយាយថា', 'នៅមានពិធីចុះស្រែផង', and the final question structure are all well-formed. The omission of the explicit question marker 'តើ' does not harm grammaticality or meaning, since the interrogative force is clear from the structure and punctuation.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that closely matches the human reference and faithfully conveys the source. It preserves the cultural and religious context of Neak Ta worship, uses appropriate Khmer/K Khmer Krom vocabulary, maintains correct pronoun relations, and reads naturally. Any differences from the reference are stylistic rather than erroneous.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Lễ xuống đồng thực ra không hề tồn tại trong văn hóa Khmer, bà con chỉ bắt tay vào trồng ngay mà không có nghi thức nào.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ៖ ពិធីចុះដាំណាំ គឺជាពិធីមួយដើម្បីចាប់ផ្តើមរដូវដាំដុះ អាចារ្យធ្វើពិធីបូជា ឬព្រះសង្ឃសូត្រធម៌ចំរើនព្រះបរិត្តដែលជានិមិត្តរូបនៃការចាប់ផ្តើមរដូវដាំដុះ ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ៖ ពិធីចុះស្រែ តាមពិតទៅ អត់មានក្នុងវប្បធម៌ខ្មែរទេ បងប្អូនគ្រាន់តែចាប់ផ្តើមដាំភ្លាមៗ អត់មានធ្វើពិធីអីទាំងអស់។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Lễ xuống giống là nghi lễ mở đầu mùa gieo trồng. Vị À cha làm lễ cúng, hoặc chư tăng tụng kinh cầu an, tượng trưng cho sự khởi đầu của mùa vụ.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the general topic marker 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ' and refers to a field/planting-related ceremony, but it directly contradicts the Human Reference. The reference states that the ceremony exists as a ritual beginning the planting season, involving an achar performing offerings or monks chanting protective blessings. The hypothesis instead states that the ceremony does not exist in Khmer culture and that people simply start planting without any ritual. This is a critical semantic reversal and omits all core ritual details from the reference.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses 'បងប្អូន' for 'bà con', which is a legitimate community-addressing kinship term in Khmer/K Khmer Krom contexts. There is no clear pronoun or honorific misuse. However, because the hypothesis omits the culturally significant actors from the reference, namely 'អាចារ្យ' and 'ព្រះសង្ឃ', it fails to represent the socially and religiously appropriate participant structure of the referenced event.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis does not appear to contain fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted character-copying. Terms such as 'ពិធីចុះស្រែ', 'វប្បធម៌ខ្មែរ', 'បងប្អូន', and 'ចាប់ផ្តើមដាំ' are legitimate Khmer expressions. Colloquial forms such as 'អត់' and 'អី' are linguistically valid, though less formal than the reference. Lexical legitimacy is therefore strong, despite the semantic mismatch.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The hypothesis is grammatically fluent and natural in colloquial Khmer. Word order and clause linkage are acceptable: 'តាមពិតទៅ', 'អត់មានក្នុង...', and 'គ្រាន់តែចាប់ផ្តើម...' flow naturally. The main weakness is not syntax but the fact that the fluent sentence conveys the opposite of the reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Although the hypothesis is linguistically fluent and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary, it is semantically incompatible with the Human Reference. The central proposition is reversed: the reference affirms the existence and ritual meaning of the ceremony, while the hypothesis denies its existence and denies any ritual practice. This makes the translation unusable for informational fidelity. Pronoun and lexical choices are mostly acceptable in isolation, but the religious and cultural participant roles in the reference are entirely omitted.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Trong lễ xuống đồng, bà con có những hoạt động nào thể hiện tinh thần đoàn kết và gắn kết cộng đồng không?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: ក្នុង​ពិធី​ចុះ​ស្រែ តើប្រជាជន​មាន​សកម្មភាព​អ្វី​ខ្លះ​ដែល​បង្ហាញ​ពី​ស្មារតី​សាមគ្គី និង​ការ​ភ្ជាប់​ទំនាក់ទំនង​សហគមន៍?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសួរ៖ ក្នុងពិធីចុះស្រែ បងប្អូនមានសកម្មភាពអ្វីខ្លះ ដែលបង្ហាញពីស្មារតីសាមគ្គី និងការចងភ្ជាប់គ្នាក្នុងសហគមន៍ទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Trong lễ xuống đồng, người dân có những hoạt động gì thể hiện tinh thần đoàn kết và sự gắn kết cộng đồng?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source and reference: the interviewer asks about activities during the 'ពិធីចុះស្រែ' that demonstrate solidarity and community cohesion. 'បងប្អូន' appropriately renders 'bà con' as a community-oriented address. The phrase 'ការចងភ្ជាប់គ្នាក្នុងសហគមន៍' conveys the idea of community bonding, close to the reference's 'ការ​ភ្ជាប់​ទំនាក់ទំនង​សហគមន៍'. The only minor issue is the final particle 'ទេ' after a wh-question structure, which slightly changes the naturalness rather than the core meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject and address terms are culturally appropriate. 'អ្នកសួរ' is slightly less formal than 'អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍' but still accurately identifies the interviewer. 'បងប្អូន' is a legitimate and natural communal kinship term corresponding to Vietnamese 'bà con', especially acceptable in Khmer Krom/Southern Vietnam sociolinguistic contexts. No disrespectful or socially inappropriate pronouns are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw character-copying from Vietnamese. Key terms such as 'ពិធីចុះស្រែ', 'សកម្មភាព', 'ស្មារតីសាមគ្គី', and 'សហគមន៍' are legitimate Khmer lexical items. 'បងប្អូន' is also an authentic kinship/community term, not a transliteration artifact.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is mostly fluent and understandable in Khmer. Word order is natural overall: setting phrase, subject, predicate, and relative clause are all clearly structured. However, the ending 'អ្វីខ្លះ ... ទេ?' is somewhat awkward because Khmer wh-questions typically do not require the yes/no particle 'ទេ' in this configuration. This creates a minor syntactic/pragmatic awkwardness compared with the more native reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is high quality and preserves the informational content, cultural context, and community-oriented address of the source. It uses authentic Khmer vocabulary and no false transliteration. Minor deductions are warranted for the slightly less formal rendering of 'interviewer' as 'អ្នកសួរ' and especially the somewhat unnatural combination of 'អ្វីខ្លះ' with final 'ទេ'. These issues do not seriously affect comprehension or cultural appropriateness.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Mọi người cùng nhau tham gia, vừa làm ruộng vừa hát dân ca, tạo bầu không khí vui vẻ, khích lệ tinh thần làm việc tập thể.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: មនុស្ស​គ្រប់​គ្នា​ចូលរួម​ជាមួយ​គ្នា ទាំង​ធ្វើ​ស្រែ​ផង ទាំង​ច្រៀង​ចម្រៀង​ប្រជាប្រិយ​ផង, បង្កើត​បរិយាកាស​រីករាយ, លើក​ទឹកចិត្ត​ស្មារតី​ធ្វើការងារ​ជា​ក្រុម។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ មនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នាចូលរួមគ្នា ទាំងធ្វើស្រែ ទាំងច្រៀងចម្រៀងប្រជាប្រិយ បង្កើតបរិយាកាសសប្បាយរីករាយ លើកកម្លាំងចិត្តក្នុងការធ្វើការរួមគ្នា។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Dân tộc Khmer: Mọi người cùng tham gia, vừa làm ruộng vừa hát những bài dân ca, tạo nên bầu không khí vui tươi, khích lệ tinh thần làm việc tập thể.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves all core informational units from the source and reference: Khmer people, everyone participating together, doing rice-field work while singing folk songs, creating a happy atmosphere, and encouraging collective work spirit. The rendering of 'ធ្វើការរួមគ្នា' for 'ធ្វើការងារ​ជា​ក្រុម' is semantically equivalent, though slightly less explicitly 'team-based' than the reference. Overall fidelity is very strong.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The phrase 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' is acceptable for 'Người Khmer/Khmer people', although the reference's 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ' is slightly more formal and ethnonymic. There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorific mismatches. The communal subject 'មនុស្សគ្រប់គ្នា' is appropriate and culturally neutral.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted copied Vietnamese forms are present. Lexical choices such as 'ចម្រៀងប្រជាប្រិយ', 'បរិយាកាសសប្បាយរីករាយ', and 'លើកកម្លាំងចិត្ត' are legitimate Khmer expressions. The vocabulary is authentic and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The word order and clause sequencing are natural Khmer: subject followed by coordinated activities with 'ទាំង...ទាំង...', then result clauses. The omission of repeated 'ផង' compared with the reference does not harm grammaticality or meaning. The phrase 'លើកកម្លាំងចិត្តក្នុងការធ្វើការរួមគ្នា' flows acceptably, though the reference's 'លើក​ទឹកចិត្ត​ស្មារតី​ធ្វើការងារ​ជា​ក្រុម' is somewhat more idiomatic and closer to the Vietnamese source.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately transfers the source meaning and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary. Minor differences in formality and idiomatic phrasing do not significantly affect comprehension or cultural appropriateness. There are no serious semantic omissions, pronoun errors, syntactic failures, or transliteration artifacts.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Tôi tò mò, người Khmer có quan niệm gì đặc biệt về vũ trụ quan nông nghiệp khi canh tác không?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: ខ្ញុំ​ចង់​ដឹង តើ​ជនជាតិ​ខ្មែរ​មាន​ទស្សនៈ​ពិសេស​អ្វី​អំពី​ចក្រវាឡ​កសិកម្ម​នៅ​ពេល​ធ្វើ​កសិកម្ម?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ ខ្ញុំឆ្ងល់ថា ជនជាតិខ្មែរមានគំនិតយល់ឃើញអ្វីពិសេសពីចក្រវាឡទស្សនៈកសិកម្ម ពេលធ្វើស្រែធ្វើចម្ការ អត់?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Tôi muốn biết, người Khmer có quan niệm đặc biệt gì về vũ trụ nông nghiệp khi làm nông không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main communicative intent: an interviewer asks out of curiosity whether Khmer people have any special conception or worldview related to agriculture during cultivation. The rendering of “canh tác” as “ធ្វើស្រែធ្វើចម្ការ” is semantically acceptable and culturally natural, specifying rice-field and garden cultivation. “Tôi tò mò” is rendered as “ខ្ញុំឆ្ងល់ថា,” which is close to the reference’s “ខ្ញុំចង់ដឹង.” The main weakness is the phrase “ចក្រវាឡទស្សនៈកសិកម្ម,” which awkwardly reorders the idea of “vũ trụ quan nông nghiệp” and is less clear than the reference “ទស្សនៈ...អំពីចក្រវាឡកសិកម្ម.” Still, the core meaning remains recoverable.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject and pronoun choices are appropriate. “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍” correctly identifies the interviewer, and “ខ្ញុំ” is the correct first-person pronoun in this neutral interview context. “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ” is respectful and contextually suitable for referring to Khmer people. There are no breaches of kinship, hierarchy, or religious respect protocols.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis does not contain fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted character-copying. Lexical items such as “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍,” “ខ្ញុំឆ្ងល់,” “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ,” “គំនិតយល់ឃើញ,” and “ធ្វើស្រែធ្វើចម្ការ” are legitimate Khmer expressions. The issue with “ចក្រវាឡទស្សនៈកសិកម្ម” is not fake transliteration but rather awkward lexical compounding and word order.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is broadly understandable and mostly natural, but there are morpho-syntactic rough spots. “មានគំនិតយល់ឃើញអ្វីពិសេសពី...” would be more natural with “អំពី” rather than “ពី” in this abstract conceptual context. The compound “ចក្រវាឡទស្សនៈកសិកម្ម” is syntactically awkward for “agricultural worldview/cosmology.” The final “អត់?” adds a colloquial yes-no question marker after an already wh-marked phrase “អ្វីពិសេស,” which makes the question slightly less polished than the reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a good translation with the essential meaning preserved and no culturally inappropriate pronouns or false transliterations. It is somewhat less polished than the human reference because of the awkward handling of the abstract term “vũ trụ quan nông nghiệp” and the colloquial final question marker. These issues affect fluency and precision but do not make the message unrecoverable.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Người Khmer tin rằng vũ trụ có sự hòa hợp giữa đất, nước, gió, lửa, và nông nghiệp phải thuận theo quy luật đó.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: ជនជាតិ​ខ្មែរ​ជឿថា ចក្រវាឡ​មាន​ភាព​ចុះ​សម្រុង​គ្នា​រវាង​ដី ទឹក ខ្យល់ ភ្លើង ហើយ​កសិកម្ម​ត្រូវ​តែ​អនុវត្ត​តាម​ច្បាប់​នោះ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ អ្នកខ្មែរជឿថា ចក្រវាលមានការសមស្របគ្នារវាងដី ទឹក ខ្យល់ ភ្លើង ហើយការធ្វើស្រែចម្ការត្រូវតែទៅតាមច្បាប់ធម្មជាតិនោះ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Dân tộc Khmer: Người Khmer tin rằng vũ trụ có sự hài hòa giữa đất, nước, gió và lửa, và việc canh tác nông nghiệp phải tuân theo quy luật ấy.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the central proposition: Khmer people believe the universe involves a harmonious/compatible relation among earth, water, wind, and fire, and farming/agriculture must follow that order. The rendering of 'nông nghiệp' as 'ការធ្វើស្រែចម្ការ' is contextually accurate for agriculture/farming. The phrase 'ច្បាប់ធម្មជាតិនោះ' adds 'natural' to 'that law/rule,' which is not explicitly in the reference, but it is a reasonable inference from the cosmological context. 'ការសមស្របគ្នា' is slightly less precise than 'ភាពចុះសម្រុងគ្នា' for 'harmony,' but the meaning remains recoverable and largely faithful.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics in this sentence. The hypothesis uses 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' for 'Người Khmer,' while the reference uses the more formal ethnic designation 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ.' 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' is acceptable and understandable as 'Khmer people,' though slightly less formal/ethnographic than the reference. No social hierarchy or religious respect issue is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis contains legitimate Khmer vocabulary: 'អ្នកខ្មែរ,' 'ជឿថា,' 'ចក្រវាល,' 'ដី,' 'ទឹក,' 'ខ្យល់,' 'ភ្លើង,' 'ការធ្វើស្រែចម្ការ,' and 'ច្បាប់ធម្មជាតិ.' There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw Vietnamese character-copying. The spelling 'ចក្រវាល' is a legitimate Khmer form.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is syntactically natural and readable in Khmer. The sequencing of clauses mirrors the source and reference appropriately. 'ត្រូវតែទៅតាមច្បាប់ធម្មជាតិនោះ' is idiomatic, though slightly more colloquial than the reference's 'ត្រូវតែអនុវត្តតាមច្បាប់នោះ.' Modifier and coordination structures are clear.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a high-quality translation. It accurately conveys the intended message with only minor lexical and stylistic deviations from the human reference. The main differences are the less formal subject term 'អ្នកខ្មែរ,' the slightly less exact 'ការសមស្របគ្នា' for harmony, and the small addition of 'ធម្មជាតិ' to 'law.' These do not cause serious semantic distortion. The output is fluent, culturally appropriate, and lexically legitimate.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Như vậy, có thể thấy việc trồng trọt không chỉ là lao động sản xuất mà còn gắn liền với tín ngưỡng và triết lý?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: ដូចនេះ, អាច​ឃើញ​ថា​ការ​ដាំដុះ​មិន​ត្រឹមតែ​ជា​កម្លាំង​ពលកម្ម​ផលិតកម្ម​ប៉ុណ្ណោះ​ទេ ថែមទាំង​ជាប់​ទាក់ទង​នឹង​ជំនឿ​និង​ទស្សនវិជ្ជា​ទៀត​ផង?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ ដូច្នេះ អាចឃើញថា ការធ្វើស្រែធ្វើចម្ការ មិនមែនត្រឹមតែជាការងារផលិតកម្មទេ តែថែមទាំងជាប់ទាក់ទងនឹងជំនឿ និងទស្សនវិជ្ជាផងដែរ មែនទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Như vậy, có thể thấy việc trồng trọt không chỉ là hoạt động lao động sản xuất, mà còn gắn liền với tín ngưỡng và triết lý nữa phải không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core proposition of the source and reference: cultivation/farming is not merely productive labor/work but is also connected with belief and philosophy. The rendering “ការធ្វើស្រែធ្វើចម្ការ” accurately conveys the broader agricultural/cultivation meaning of “việc trồng trọt.” “ការងារផលិតកម្ម” is a natural equivalent for “lao động sản xuất,” though slightly less formal than the reference’s “កម្លាំង​ពលកម្ម​ផលិតកម្ម.” The final tag “មែនទេ?” is an added confirmation marker, but it fits the interrogative framing of the source and does not distort the meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The speaker role “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍” is correctly preserved. There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics in this sentence. The neutral interviewer framing is pragmatically appropriate and culturally unobjectionable.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions. “ការធ្វើស្រែធ្វើចម្ការ,” “ការងារផលិតកម្ម,” “ជំនឿ,” and “ទស្សនវិជ្ជា” are authentic and contextually suitable. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or mechanically copied Vietnamese forms.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has fluent Khmer structure: “មិនមែនត្រឹមតែជា...ទេ តែថែមទាំង...” is natural and correctly expresses the Vietnamese ‘không chỉ... mà còn...’ construction. Word order and clause linkage are smooth. The added “មែនទេ?” makes the question conversational and natural.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately transfers the informational content, maintains appropriate pragmatic framing, uses authentic Khmer vocabulary, and has natural morpho-syntactic flow. Minor stylistic differences from the reference, such as using “ការងារ” instead of a more formal labor term and adding “មែនទេ?,” do not meaningfully reduce fidelity.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Đúng vậy, từ cúng Neak Ta, lễ xuống đồng đến vũ trụ quan nông nghiệp, tất cả tạo nên một hệ giá trị bền vững.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: ត្រឹមត្រូវ​ហើយ, ចាប់ពី​ការ​បន់ស្រន់​អ្នកតា, ពិធី​ចុះ​ស្រែ រហូត​ដល់​ទស្សនៈ​ចក្រវាឡ​កសិកម្ម, ទាំង​អស់​នេះ​បង្កើត​បាន​ជា​ប្រព័ន្ធ​តម្លៃ​ដ៏​ស្ថិតស្ថេរ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ មែនហើយ ពីការសែនអ្នកតា ពិធីចុះស្រែ រហូតដល់ទស្សនៈចក្កវាឡខាងកសិកម្ម ទាំងអស់ហ្នឹងបានបង្កើតជាប្រព័ន្ធតម្លៃមាំមួនយូរអង្វែង។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Đúng vậy, từ việc cầu khấn Neak Tà, nghi lễ xuống đồng cho đến quan niệm về vũ trụ nông nghiệp, tất cả đã tạo nên một hệ giá trị bền vững.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves all core informational units: affirmation, the sequence from Neak Ta worship/offering, the field-entering agricultural ritual, the agricultural cosmological worldview, and the conclusion that these elements form a durable value system. The rendering 'ការសែនអ្នកតា' is semantically appropriate for 'cúng Neak Ta' and arguably close to the Vietnamese ritual sense. 'ទស្សនៈចក្កវាឡខាងកសិកម្ម' successfully conveys 'vũ trụ quan nông nghiệp', though slightly less compact than the reference. No critical omissions or distortions are present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The speaker label 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' is acceptable for 'Người Khmer', though slightly more colloquial and less ethnological/formal than the reference 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ'. There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics. The culturally relevant term 'អ្នកតា' is preserved correctly and respectfully.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses authentic Khmer vocabulary: 'សែនអ្នកតា', 'ពិធីចុះស្រែ', 'ទស្សនៈចក្កវាឡ', 'កសិកម្ម', and 'ប្រព័ន្ធតម្លៃ'. There is no evidence of fake phonetic copying or illegitimate transliteration from Vietnamese. The spelling 'ចក្កវាឡ' is a legitimate Khmer form related to cosmological vocabulary.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The syntax is fluent and natural in Khmer. The sequence 'ពី... រហូតដល់...' is clear, and the concluding clause 'ទាំងអស់ហ្នឹងបានបង្កើតជា...' is idiomatic, though somewhat more colloquial than the reference because of 'ហ្នឹង'. Modifier placement and phrase ordering are acceptable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately conveys the source meaning and retains the Khmer cultural-religious terminology. Minor stylistic differences exist, especially the more colloquial 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' and 'ហ្នឹង', but they do not harm comprehension or cultural appropriateness. The translation is semantically complete, culturally sound, grammatically fluent, and lexically legitimate.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Anh có thể chia sẻ những phong tục mà người Khmer thường thực hiện trước các ngày lễ tôn giáo quan trọng không?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: តើបងអាចចែករំលែកអំពី ទំនៀមទម្លាប់ ដែលជនជាតិខ្មែរតែងតែអនុវត្តមុនថ្ងៃ បុណ្យសាសនា សំខាន់ៗបានទេ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ បងអាចចែករំលែកអំពីទំនៀមទម្លាប់ ដែលបងប្អូនខ្មែរយើងតែងធ្វើ មុនដល់ថ្ងៃបុណ្យសាសនាសំខាន់ៗ បានទេ?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content of the source and reference: the interviewer asks whether the addressee can share customs that Khmer people usually perform before important religious holidays. The phrase "តែងធ្វើ" accurately corresponds to "តែងតែអនុវត្ត" / "thường thực hiện". The only slight semantic-pragmatic shift is "បងប្អូនខ្មែរយើង" instead of the more neutral "ជនជាតិខ្មែរ", adding an in-group communal nuance, but it does not distort the meaning.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of "បង" for Vietnamese "Anh" is appropriate and culturally natural in Khmer/K Khmer Krom interactional style. The expression "បងប្អូនខ្មែរយើង" is pragmatically acceptable as a localized, inclusive way to refer to the Khmer community, especially in Khmer Krom sociolinguistic contexts. No disrespectful or socially inappropriate pronoun choice is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as "អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍", "ទំនៀមទម្លាប់", "ថ្ងៃបុណ្យសាសនា", and "សំខាន់ៗ" are authentic and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is fluent and natural in Khmer. Word order is idiomatic: "បងអាចចែករំលែកអំពី...បានទេ" forms a clear question, and "មុនដល់ថ្ងៃបុណ្យសាសនាសំខាន់ៗ" is grammatical and understandable. The omission of the initial question marker "តើ" does not harm grammaticality because "បានទេ" sufficiently marks the interrogative.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a high-quality translation that preserves the meaning, cultural context, and pragmatic force of the source. Minor differences from the reference are stylistic rather than substantive, especially the warmer inclusive phrase "បងប្អូនខ្មែរយើង". It is fluent, culturally appropriate, and lexically legitimate, with no fake transliteration or serious grammatical issue.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Trước tiên, mọi gia đình đều tiến hành dọn dẹp nhà cửa thật sạch sẽ, vì tin rằng không gian trong lành sẽ đón nhiều may mắn.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: មុនដំបូង, ក្រុមគ្រួសារនីមួយៗសុទ្ធតែចាប់ផ្តើម សម្អាតផ្ទះសម្បែង ឱ្យបានស្អាតបាត ព្រោះជឿថា ទីកន្លែងបរិសុទ្ធ នឹងអាចទទួលនូវ សិរីមង្គល បានច្រើន។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ មុនគេ គ្រប់គ្រួសារទាំងអស់តែងនាំគ្នាបោសសម្អាតផ្ទះសំបែងអោយស្អាតស្អំ ព្រោះជឿថាបរិយាកាសស្រស់ស្រាយនឹងនាំសំណាងល្អចូលមកច្រើន។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Trước hết, mỗi gia đình đều bắt đầu dọn dẹp nhà cửa cho thật sạch sẽ, vì họ tin rằng nơi chốn thanh sạch sẽ đón nhận được nhiều điều tốt lành.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core proposition very well: Khmer people first clean their houses thoroughly because they believe a fresh/clean environment will bring much good luck. The rendering of “mọi gia đình đều” as “គ្រប់គ្រួសារទាំងអស់” is semantically accurate. “បោសសម្អាតផ្ទះ...” captures the cleaning activity, and “បរិយាកាសស្រស់ស្រាយនឹងនាំសំណាងល្អចូលមកច្រើន” accurately conveys the belief that a pleasant/clean space brings much luck. There is a slight shift from “không gian trong lành” as ‘clean/pure space’ to “បរិយាកាសស្រស់ស្រាយ” as ‘refreshing atmosphere,’ but this remains faithful in context.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject phrase “អ្នកខ្មែរ” is acceptable for “Người Khmer,” though the reference uses the more formal “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ.” There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics in this sentence. The hypothesis does not violate Khmer Krom sociolinguistic or religious-pragmatic norms.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer and does not show fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as “មុនគេ,” “គ្រប់គ្រួសារ,” “បោសសម្អាត,” “បរិយាកាស,” and “សំណាងល្អ” are authentic and contextually appropriate. The form “ផ្ទះសំបែង” appears to be a minor spelling/orthographic issue compared with the standard “ផ្ទះសម្បែង,” but it is not a fake transliteration and does not obstruct understanding.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence flows naturally in Khmer. Word order is idiomatic: subject/topic, temporal adverbial, family group, action, purpose/result clause, and causal belief clause. “តែងនាំគ្នាបោសសម្អាត” is fluent, though it adds a slight collective nuance ‘do together’ not explicitly present in the source. The overall syntax is coherent and native-like.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a strong translation with full recoverability of the original meaning and culturally appropriate Khmer wording. Minor issues include a slight semantic shift in “បរិយាកាសស្រស់ស្រាយ,” the added nuance of collective action in “នាំគ្នា,” and the spelling issue “ផ្ទះសំបែង.” These do not seriously affect comprehension or fidelity. No pronoun or honorific problems are present, and there is no illegitimate transliteration.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Việc dọn dẹp này chỉ mang ý nghĩa vệ sinh hay còn có yếu tố tinh thần đặc biệt nào khác?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: តើការសម្អាតនេះគ្រាន់តែមានន័យថាជា អនាម័យ ប៉ុណ្ណោះទេ ឬក៏មាន កត្តាផ្លូវចិត្ត ពិសេសអ្វីផ្សេងទៀត?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ ការសម្អាតនេះ គ្រាន់តែមានន័យខាងអនាម័យទេ ឬក៏នៅមានកត្តាផ្លូវជំនឿពិសេសអីផ្សេងទៀត?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Việc làm sạch này chỉ có nghĩa là giữ vệ sinh thôi, hay còn có yếu tố tâm lý đặc biệt nào khác nữa?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main informational content: the interviewer asks whether the cleaning has only a hygienic meaning or whether it also has another special non-material/spiritual factor. The phrase “មានន័យខាងអនាម័យ” accurately renders the hygiene-related meaning. The phrase “កត្តាផ្លូវជំនឿ” shifts the reference’s “កត្តាផ្លូវចិត្ត” and the Vietnamese “yếu tố tinh thần” toward a more belief/faith-oriented interpretation. This is not a major distortion because “tinh thần” can cover spiritual or belief-related dimensions, but it is slightly narrower than the reference’s more general mental/spiritual phrasing.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The speaker label “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍” is correctly retained. There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, honorifics, or religious respect markers in the sentence. The interrogative form is socially neutral and appropriate for an interview context.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions. “អនាម័យ,” “កត្តា,” “ផ្លូវជំនឿ,” and “ពិសេស” are authentic and contextually understandable. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or character-copying from Vietnamese. The colloquial interrogative “អី” is acceptable and does not damage comprehension.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has natural Khmer word order and flows well: topic phrase followed by the alternative question structure “គ្រាន់តែ...ទេ ឬក៏...”. The use of “នៅមាន” is idiomatic and reinforces the sense of 'also/still having' another factor. Punctuation and spacing are acceptable.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation. The core question, speaker role, and contrast between hygiene-only meaning versus an additional special intangible factor are preserved. The only notable issue is the semantic narrowing of “ផ្លូវចិត្ត/tinh thần” to “ផ្លូវជំនឿ,” which leans more toward belief or faith than the broader mental/spiritual sense in the reference. Pronoun handling, syntax, and lexical legitimacy are excellent.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Nó còn là cách loại bỏ những điều không may của năm cũ, chuẩn bị tâm thế thanh tịnh để bước vào ngày lễ.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: វាក៏ជាវិធីមួយដើម្បី បំបាត់នូវរឿងមិនល្អ នៃឆ្នាំចាស់, រៀបចំ ផ្លូវចិត្តឱ្យបរិសុទ្ធ ដើម្បីឈានចូលទៅដល់ថ្ងៃបុណ្យ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ នេះក៏ជាវិធីមួយបំបាត់រឿងស៊យៗក្នុងឆ្នាំចាស់ រៀបចំចិត្តឲ្យជ្រះថ្លា ដើម្បីឈានចូលថ្ងៃបុណ្យ។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Đó cũng là một cách để xua đi những điều không tốt của năm cũ, chuẩn bị tâm hồn thanh tịnh để bước vào ngày lễ.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source and reference: it states that this is also a way to remove unlucky/bad things from the old year and prepare a pure/clear mental state before entering the festival day. The shift from 'វា' to 'នេះ' does not alter the meaning. 'រឿងស៊យៗ' accurately conveys 'điều không may' / 'រឿងមិនល្អ', though in a slightly more colloquial register. No critical information is omitted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The label 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' is acceptable for 'Người Khmer', though the reference uses the more formal ethnonym 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ'. There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorifics in this sentence. The sentence does not involve hierarchical or religious address requiring special pragmatic marking.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The vocabulary is legitimate Khmer. 'ស៊យៗ' is a recognizable colloquial Khmer expression meaning unlucky or unfortunate, not a fake phonetic transliteration. Other terms such as 'វិធី', 'បំបាត់', 'ឆ្នាំចាស់', 'ចិត្ត', 'ជ្រះថ្លា', and 'ថ្ងៃបុណ្យ' are authentic and contextually appropriate.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The hypothesis has natural Khmer word order and good syntactic flow. 'នេះក៏ជាវិធីមួយបំបាត់...' is slightly compressed compared with the reference's 'វិធីមួយដើម្បី...', but it remains grammatical and fluent. 'រៀបចំចិត្តឲ្យជ្រះថ្លា' is idiomatic and semantically close to preparing a purified mindset.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the translation is high quality and accurately transfers the meaning of the source. It uses natural Khmer syntax and acceptable vocabulary. The main difference from the reference is register: 'រឿងស៊យៗ' is more colloquial than 'រឿងមិនល្អ', and 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' is slightly less formal than 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ'. These are minor and do not damage meaning or cultural appropriateness.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Tôi nghe nói bà con cũng chú trọng việc sửa sang nhà cửa trước lễ, có đúng không?

per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ ខ្ញុំឮថា បងប្អូនក៏យកចិត្តទុកដាក់ជួសជុលតុបតែងផ្ទះសម្បែងមុនថ្ងៃបុណ្យ ដូច្នេះមែនទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Tôi nghe nói bà con cũng chú ý sửa sang nhà cửa trước dịp lễ, có đúng vậy không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core message of the source and reference: the interviewer says they have heard that the community pays attention to fixing up houses before the festival and asks for confirmation. The addition of "តុបតែង" meaning "decorate" is not a harmful distortion because Vietnamese "sửa sang nhà cửa" can naturally include renovating, tidying, and beautifying the house. "មុនថ្ងៃបុណ្យ" is equivalent in context to "មុនពេលបុណ្យ" / before the festival. No important information is omitted.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses "អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍" for interviewer, "ខ្ញុំ" for the first-person speaker, and "បងប្អូន" for bà con/community members. These are socially and pragmatically appropriate in Khmer Krom/Vietnamese-Khmer community discourse. There is no misuse of hierarchy, kinship, or honorific terms.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions: "អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍", "ខ្ញុំឮថា", "បងប្អូន", "យកចិត្តទុកដាក់", "ជួសជុល", "តុបតែង", "ផ្ទះសម្បែង", and "បុណ្យ" are valid and contextually appropriate. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw Vietnamese copying.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically natural and fluent in Khmer. The phrase "យកចិត្តទុកដាក់ជួសជុលតុបតែងផ្ទះសម្បែង" is acceptable, though slightly more compressed than the reference form with "លើការ". The confirmation question "ដូច្នេះមែនទេ?" is natural and conveys the intended pragmatic force.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a high-quality translation that accurately preserves the meaning, speaker role, community reference, and pragmatic intent of the source. The added nuance of decorating is compatible with the Vietnamese expression "sửa sang" and does not introduce a factual error. Pronoun and kinship choices are culturally sound, vocabulary is authentic, and the syntax is fluent. Overall, it is essentially equivalent to the human reference with only very minor stylistic variation.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Đúng vậy, từ sơn phết, thay mái lá, sửa bàn thờ, đến trang trí sân vườn, tất cả thể hiện sự trân trọng tổ tiên và thần linh.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: ត្រូវហើយ ចាប់ពីការ លាបថ្នាំ ផ្លាស់ប្តូរដំបូលស្លឹក ជួសជុលទីសក្ការៈបូជា រហូតដល់ តុបតែងសួនច្បារ ទាំងអស់នេះបង្ហាញពីការ គោរពដូនតា និង ទេវតា។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកខ្មែរ៖ មែនហើយ ចាប់ពីលាបស៊ឺន ប្ដូរដំបូលស្លឹក ជួសជុលអាសនៈបូជា ដល់តុបតែងទីធ្លាសួនច្បារ ទាំងអស់នេះបង្ហាញពីការគោរពដូនតា និងទេវតា។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Đúng vậy, từ việc sơn phết, thay mái lá, sửa chữa nơi thờ tự cho đến trang trí khu vườn, tất cả đều thể hiện lòng tôn kính tổ tiên và các vị thần.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves almost all core informational units: the Khmer speaker affirms the statement, lists painting, changing the leaf roof, repairing the worship altar, decorating the yard/garden, and states that these actions show respect for ancestors and deities. The meanings of 'ប្ដូរដំបូលស្លឹក', 'ជួសជុលអាសនៈបូជា', and 'គោរពដូនតា និងទេវតា' align well with the source and reference. The main semantic weakness is 'លាបស៊ឺន' for 'sơn phết'; while the intended meaning is recoverable from 'លាប', the element 'ស៊ឺន' appears to be a Vietnamese phonetic borrowing rather than the natural Khmer 'លាបថ្នាំ/ថ្នាំលាប'.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The speaker label 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' is acceptable for 'Người Khmer', though slightly less formal/ethnic-category-like than the reference 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ'. There are no problematic pronouns or kinship terms. Religious respect is maintained through 'អាសនៈបូជា', 'គោរព', 'ដូនតា', and 'ទេវតា'. No breach of Khmer Krom social or religious pragmatics is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: Most lexical choices are legitimate Khmer: 'មែនហើយ', 'ប្ដូរដំបូលស្លឹក', 'ជួសជុលអាសនៈបូជា', 'ទីធ្លាសួនច្បារ', 'គោរពដូនតា', and 'ទេវតា' are all acceptable. However, 'ស៊ឺន' in 'លាបស៊ឺន' appears to be a raw phonetic rendering of Vietnamese 'sơn' rather than an authentic Khmer lexical item. This is a notable lexical legitimacy problem, although it is only one item and the broader sentence remains understandable.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence flows naturally overall. The list structure beginning with 'ចាប់ពី...' and continuing through 'ដល់...' is understandable, though the reference's 'រហូតដល់' would be slightly more idiomatic for the full range construction. The lack of nominalizing 'ការ' before some listed activities is acceptable in colloquial Khmer but somewhat less polished than the reference. Word order is generally sound.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is largely faithful and fluent, with appropriate handling of religious and ancestral respect. The major issue is lexical: 'លាបស៊ឺន' likely reflects Vietnamese-to-Khmer phonetic copying and should have been rendered as 'លាបថ្នាំ' or similar. Because the rest of the sentence is semantically accurate and pragmatically appropriate, the semantic and morpho-syntactic scores remain high, but the lexical legitimacy score is penalized substantially under the anti-false-transliteration criterion.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Ngoài dọn dẹp và sửa sang, bước quan trọng khác chắc hẳn là chuẩn bị lễ vật?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: ក្រៅពីការសម្អាត និងជួសជុល ជំហានសំខាន់មួយទៀតប្រាកដជាការ រៀបចំគ្រឿងដង្វាយ?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ ក្រៅពីបោសសម្អាត និងជួសជុលរៀបចំ ជំហានសំខាន់មួយទៀត ច្បាស់ជាការរៀបចំគ្រឿងសែនមែនទេ?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Ngoài việc dọn dẹp và sửa chữa, một bước quan trọng khác chắc hẳn là chuẩn bị lễ vật dâng cúng phải không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source and reference: the interviewer asks whether, besides cleaning and repairing/renovating, another important step is preparing ceremonial offerings. The phrase “បោសសម្អាត” adequately renders “dọn dẹp,” and “ជួសជុលរៀបចំ” broadly covers “sửa sang,” though it is slightly less clean than the reference’s simpler “ជួសជុល.” “គ្រឿងសែន” conveys offerings and is semantically close to “គ្រឿងដង្វាយ,” although it has a somewhat more specific ritual/ancestral-sacrificial nuance. The added tag “មែនទេ?” is pragmatically compatible with the Vietnamese question form “chắc hẳn ... ?” and does not distort the proposition.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The speaker label “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍” correctly matches “Người phỏng vấn” and the human reference. There are no problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorific mismatches. The sentence is a neutral interviewer question and does not require special hierarchical marking.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or mechanically copied Vietnamese forms appear. All main lexical items are legitimate Khmer: “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍,” “បោសសម្អាត,” “ជួសជុល,” “ជំហានសំខាន់,” “រៀបចំ,” and “គ្រឿងសែន.” The term “គ្រឿងសែន” is authentic Khmer ritual vocabulary, not a transliteration error, though it differs slightly in ritual nuance from the reference “គ្រឿងដង្វាយ.”
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The overall word order is natural and intelligible. The structure “ក្រៅពី... ជំហានសំខាន់មួយទៀត...” follows Khmer syntax well. The only minor issue is the compound sequence “ជួសជុលរៀបចំ,” which feels slightly compressed or awkward compared with a more fluent coordinated phrase such as “ជួសជុល និងរៀបចំ” or the reference’s “ជួសជុល.” Otherwise, the sentence flows acceptably.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately conveys the interviewer’s question and uses authentic Khmer vocabulary. The translation is not corrupted and shows no false transliteration. Minor issues include a slight semantic narrowing from “គ្រឿងដង្វាយ” to “គ្រឿងសែន” and a somewhat awkward phrase “ជួសជុលរៀបចំ,” but these do not prevent comprehension or materially alter the core message.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Chính xác, lễ vật thường gồm hoa, trái cây, cốm dẹp, nhang đèn, đôi khi còn có bánh dân gian truyền thống để dâng cúng.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: ពិតប្រាកដណាស់ គ្រឿងដង្វាយ ជាធម្មតាមាន ផ្កា ផ្លែឈើ អំបុក ធូបទៀន, ជួនកាលក៏មាន នំប្រពៃណី ផងដែរដើម្បី ថ្វាយសែន ។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ខ្មែរ៖ ត្រូវហើយ របស់សែនភាគច្រើនមានផ្កា ផ្លែឈើ អំបុក ធូប ទៀន ជួនកាលក៏មាននំប្រពៃណីបុរាណ ដើម្បីថ្វាយសែន។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Đúng vậy, lễ vật dâng cúng thường có hoa, trái cây, cốm dẹp, nhang đèn; đôi khi còn có cả bánh truyền thống để dâng cúng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content: the speaker is Khmer, confirms correctness, and lists the ritual offerings as flowers, fruit, ambok/cốm dẹp, incense, candles, and sometimes traditional cakes for offering. The phrase 'ភាគច្រើន' means 'mostly/for the most part', while the reference/source use 'ជាធម្មតា/thường' meaning 'usually', which is a minor nuance shift but does not distort the message. 'នំប្រពៃណីបុរាណ' adds a slightly stronger sense of 'ancient/traditional' compared with 'នំប្រពៃណី' / 'bánh dân gian truyền thống', but remains semantically compatible.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The subject label 'ខ្មែរ' is slightly shorter than the reference 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ', but it is pragmatically appropriate and does not create ambiguity in this context. No problematic pronouns, kinship terms, or honorific mismatches occur. The religious offering verb 'ថ្វាយសែន' is culturally appropriate in Khmer/Khmers Krom ritual context.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All major lexical items are legitimate Khmer vocabulary: 'របស់សែន', 'ផ្កា', 'ផ្លែឈើ', 'អំបុក', 'ធូប', 'ទៀន', 'នំប្រពៃណី', and 'ថ្វាយសែន'. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese into Khmer script. The localized religious/cultural terms are authentic and contextually suitable.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically natural and fluent in Khmer. Word order is acceptable, and the list structure is clear. Minor spacing/punctuation differences from the reference do not affect readability. The construction 'របស់សែនភាគច្រើនមាន...' is natural enough, though 'គ្រឿងដង្វាយ ជាធម្មតាមាន...' would be closer to the reference.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with the full ritual meaning preserved and culturally appropriate Khmer vocabulary. The only minor issues are small lexical-nuance differences such as 'ភាគច្រើន' for 'usually' and the addition of 'បុរាណ' to describe traditional cakes. These do not materially harm comprehension or cultural fidelity.

per_sample.text: Người phỏng vấn: Lễ vật có được lựa chọn theo tiêu chí nào không, thưa anh?
label: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍: តើ គ្រឿងដង្វាយ ត្រូវបានជ្រើសរើសតាម លក្ខណៈវិនិច្ឆ័យ ណាខ្លះដែរឬទេ បង?
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍៖ គ្រឿងសំណែនគេមានជ្រើសតាមលក្ខខណ្ឌអ្វីខ្លះអត់ បង?
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người phỏng vấn: Các lễ vật dâng cúng có được lựa chọn theo những tiêu chí nào không, anh/chị?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning of the source: the interviewer asks whether ceremonial offerings are chosen according to some criteria. The phrase “គ្រឿងសំណែន” is a plausible rendering of “lễ vật,” though it leans toward ritual/ceremonial offerings and is slightly different in nuance from the reference “គ្រឿងដង្វាយ.” The passive structure “có được lựa chọn” / “ត្រូវបានជ្រើសរើស” is rendered more colloquially as “គេមានជ្រើស,” but the informational content remains recoverable. “លក្ខខណ្ឌ” for “criteria” is acceptable but less precise than “លក្ខណៈវិនិច្ឆ័យ.”
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis retains “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍” for the interviewer and uses “បង” at the end, correctly reflecting the respectful/kinship-based address in the source “thưa anh” and the human reference. There is no inappropriate pronoun shift or breach of social hierarchy. The use of “គេ” as an impersonal/passive-like subject is natural in colloquial Khmer and does not create a pragmatic problem.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted copied Vietnamese forms appear. All lexical items are legitimate Khmer: “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍,” “គ្រឿងសំណែន,” “ជ្រើស,” “លក្ខខណ្ឌ,” “អ្វីខ្លះ,” “អត់,” and “បង.” The vocabulary is colloquial but authentic. “គ្រឿងសំណែន” is culturally plausible and should not be penalized as a false transliteration.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and natural in a colloquial Khmer register: “គ្រឿងសំណែនគេមានជ្រើសតាមលក្ខខណ្ឌអ្វីខ្លះអត់ បង?” However, compared with the reference, it is less formal and slightly compressed. The sequence “គេមានជ្រើស” is acceptable conversationally but less polished than “ត្រូវបានជ្រើសរើស.” Overall word order is clear and native-like.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation hypothesis is a good Khmer rendering of the source, with the full communicative intent preserved. It correctly handles the interviewer label and the respectful kinship address “បង.” Its main weaknesses are register and precision: “លក្ខខណ្ឌ” is somewhat less exact than “លក្ខណៈវិនិច្ឆ័យ,” and the passive/formal wording is replaced by a more colloquial construction. There are no serious semantic errors, no pronoun problems, and no illegitimate transliteration.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Phải chọn đồ tươi ngon, nguyên vẹn, màu sắc tươi sáng, bởi đó là sự thể hiện lòng thành kính với chư Phật và tổ tiên.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ: ត្រូវតែជ្រើសរើសរបស់ដែល ស្រស់ និង មានគុណភាពល្អ នៅគង់វង្ស មាន ពណ៌ស្រស់ស្អាត, ព្រោះនោះគឺជាការបង្ហាញនូវ សេចក្តីជ្រះថ្លា ចំពោះ ព្រះពុទ្ធ និង ដូនតា។
per_sample.hyp_vi_to_km: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ៖ ត្រូវរើសយករបស់ស្រស់ឆ្ងាញ់ មិនខូចមិនបាក់បែក ពណ៌ស្រស់ភ្លឺ ព្រោះនោះជាការបង្ហាញចិត្តស្មោះគោរពចំពោះព្រះពុទ្ធទាំងឡាយ និងដូនតា។
per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Phải chọn những lễ vật tươi, có chất lượng tốt, còn nguyên vẹn và màu sắc đẹp, vì đó là cách thể hiện lòng thành kính đối với Đức Phật và tổ tiên.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the full informational content of the source and closely matches the human reference. It correctly conveys that Khmer people must choose offerings/items that are fresh/good, intact, and bright in color, and that this act expresses sincere reverence toward the Buddhas and ancestors. The phrase "របស់ស្រស់ឆ្ងាញ់" appropriately reflects Vietnamese "đồ tươi ngon," and "មិនខូចមិនបាក់បែក" accurately renders the idea of being whole/intact. "ព្រះពុទ្ធទាំងឡាយ" is a suitable rendering of "chư Phật." No critical omission or distortion is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic pronouns or inappropriate subject references. The phrase "ជនជាតិខ្មែរ" is appropriate for "Người Khmer." linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “អ្នកខ្មែរ” and “ខ្មែរយើង,” which are understandable and culturally acceptable, though less formal and slightly less inclusive/respectful than the reference “ជនជាតិខ្មែរយើងខ្ញុំ.” The use of “ចាស” for Vietnamese “Dạ” is polite but may imply a feminine speaker or softer register, while the reference uses “បាទ.” Since the source does not specify speaker gender, this is not a critical error, but it is a minor pragmatic mismatch.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis does not contain fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted character copying. Words such as “អ្នកខ្មែរ,” “ទឹកចិត្ត,” “អ្នកជិតខាង,” “ស្និទ្ធ,” and “ធម៌” are legitimate Khmer lexical items. The problematic “ន័យ” is an authentic Khmer word, but it is contextually misselected rather than a transliteration error.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: Most of the sentence follows natural Khmer ordering and is intelligible. The concessive structure “ទោះ...ក៏...” is correctly formed, and the final moral-behavior clause is acceptable. The main syntactic weakness is the phrase “ឲ្យតម្លៃនឹងន័យអ្នកជិតខាង,” where the preposition/collocation and noun choice disrupt fluency. A more natural phrasing would be “ឲ្យតម្លៃដល់អ្នកជិតខាង” or a fuller rendering of neighborly obligation.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is understandable and mostly transfers the source message, but it has a clear lexical-semantic error in the rendering of “nghĩa xóm,” producing an awkward and partially misleading phrase. Pronoun and politeness choices are acceptable but somewhat less aligned with the reference’s respectful collective register. There are no fake transliterations, and the grammar is mostly serviceable aside from the neighbor-related phrase.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Trong làng Khmer, nhà nào cũng mở cửa chào nhau, không phân biệt quen hay lạ, thân hay sơ vẫn niềm nở như người nhà.

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Ở phum sóc Khmer, nhà nào cũng rộng cửa chào đón nhau; dù quen hay lạ, mọi người vẫn niềm nở như anh em một nhà.

linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no problematic personal pronouns or kinship-role mismatches. The expression 'គ្នា' is pragmatically appropriate for reciprocal greeting among villagers. 'អ្នកផ្ទះមួយគ្នា' is culturally acceptable and conveys familial closeness without breaching Khmer social hierarchy or honorific expectations.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items are legitimate Khmer expressions. There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration from Vietnamese. Terms such as 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ', 'ភូមិខ្មែរ', 'បើកទ្វារ', 'សួរស្តី', 'ស្គាល់', 'ស្និទ្ធ', and 'រួសរាយ' are authentic and contextually suitable. The choice 'សួរស្តីគ្នា' is slightly more 'greeting' than 'welcoming', but remains semantically compatible in this communal hospitality context.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is fluent and natural in Khmer. Word order is idiomatic: locative phrase first, followed by the subject phrase and predicate, then the concessive contrast structure 'មិនថា... ក៏នៅតែ...'. The parallel structure 'ស្គាល់ឬមិនស្គាល់ ស្និទ្ធឬមិនសូវស្និទ្ធ' flows well and accurately reflects the Vietnamese contrast pairs 'quen hay lạ, thân hay sơ'.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation is professional-quality overall. per_sample.text: Phỏng vấn viên: Vậy nếu không thân thiết thì có giữ khoảng cách không anh?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core conversational meaning: the interviewer asks whether distance is maintained when people are not close. ('do you maintain...'). This is a minor semantic/pragmatic shift but the main informational content remains intact.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The reference uses 'យើង' plus the respectful vocative 'បង', which matches the interview context and softens the question. This is still culturally plausible and respectful in Khmer Krom/Southern Khmer interaction, but it is less aligned with the reference’s more general/inclusive framing. No serious pronoun breach occurs.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items in the hypothesis are legitimate Khmer expressions: 'អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍', 'អញ្ចឹង', 'អត់', 'ស្និទ្ធស្នាល', 'គ្នា', 'បង', 'រក្សា', and 'គម្លាត'. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally natural and understandable. 'អញ្ចឹង បើអត់ស្និទ្ធស្នាលគ្នា' flows well. The phrase 'តើបងមានរក្សាគម្លាតអត់?' is understandable but slightly less idiomatic than the reference’s 'តើយើងគួររក្សាគម្លាតអត់', because 'មានរក្សា' can feel somewhat calqued or less smooth in this context. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The hypothesis is a good translation with preserved core meaning, respectful address, and authentic Khmer vocabulary. The main weakness is the shift from the reference’s general/inclusive 'should we maintain distance' to a more direct 'do you maintain distance', along with a mildly less natural verbal construction. These are not severe errors, and the translation remains culturally and linguistically usable.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Dạ không ạ, người Khmer luôn cố gắng hòa nhã, dù không thân thì cũng không xa lánh, vì cùng làng là cùng một cộng đồng.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ៖ បាទអត់ទេ ប្រជាជនខ្មែរតែងព្យាយាមរាក់ទាក់ ទោះអត់សូវស្និទ្ធស្នាលក៏អត់មានបោះបង់ចោលដែរ ព្រោះអ្នកភូមិយើងជាសហគមន៍តែមួយ។

per_sample.hyp_km_to_vi: Người Khmer: Dạ không, người Khmer luôn cố gắng thân thiện, dù không quá thân thiết thì cũng không bỏ mặc nhau, vì bà con trong làng chúng tôi là một cộng đồng.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the main informational content: Khmer people try to maintain harmonious relations, even without close intimacy they do not distance themselves, because people in the same village form one community. The phrase “ទោះបីមិនស្និទ្ធ ក៏អត់ឃ្លាតឆ្ងាយដែរ” accurately conveys the idea of not alienating or avoiding others. However, “ខំឲ្យបានរាបសា សុខស្រួល” is somewhat less semantically precise than the reference “ព្យាយាមរាក់ទាក់” for Vietnamese “cố gắng hòa nhã”; it leans toward being modest/easygoing/comfortable rather than explicitly friendly or cordial. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The use of “អ្នកខ្មែរ” and “អ្នកខ្មែរយើង” is pragmatically acceptable in this context and may even sound naturally inclusive for a Khmer speaker discussing their own community. The polite response marker “ចាស អត់ទេ” is acceptable, though the reference uses “បាទអត់ទេ”; this difference may indicate speaker-gender politeness variation rather than a serious error. No disrespectful or culturally inappropriate pronoun choice is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The hypothesis uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary throughout. Terms such as “អ្នកខ្មែរ,” “ស្និទ្ធ,” “ឃ្លាតឆ្ងាយ,” “ភូមិ,” and “សហគមន៍” are authentic and contextually appropriate. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally fluent and understandable in Khmer. The structure “ទោះបី...ក៏...” is natural, and the final clause “ព្រោះនៅភូមិជាមួយគ្នា គឺជាសហគមន៍តែមួយ” is clear. The main syntactic awkwardness is in “ខំឲ្យបានរាបសា សុខស្រួល,” which sounds less idiomatic than the reference’s “តែងព្យាយាមរាក់ទាក់.” Overall flow remains good, with only mild awkwardness.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation with the main meaning and community-oriented pragmatics preserved. The hypothesis differs from the reference mainly in lexical nuance for 'hòa nhã,' translating it as a broader sense of being modest/easygoing/comfortable rather than directly 'friendly/cordial.' Pronoun and politeness usage are acceptable in Khmer context, and there are no fake transliterations. Minor idiomatic and lexical precision issues prevent a perfect score.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Nếu có người mới chuyển đến, dân trong xóm thường qua chào hỏi, giúp đỡ dọn dẹp, cho mượn đồ như anh em ruột thịt.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core meaning very well: when a new person moves in, people in the village/neighborhood visit/greet them, help clean or arrange things, and lend belongings as if they were close siblings. linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: The lexical choices are legitimate Khmer expressions, not fake phonetic transliterations. “ផ្លាស់មកនៅ,” “អ្នកក្នុងភូមិ,” “សួរនាំ,” “រៀបចំសម្អាត,” “ឲ្យខ្ចី,” and “អីវ៉ាន់” are understandable and authentic. “អីវ៉ាន់” is colloquial but acceptable for belongings/items in this context. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence has natural Khmer word order and good flow. The conditional structure “បើមាន...” is fluent, and the sequence of communal actions is clearly ordered. “ទៅសួរនាំ” is slightly perspective-shifted compared with the reference’s “មកសួរសុខទុក្ខ,” but it remains grammatically and pragmatically acceptable. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately transfers the main informational content and uses culturally appropriate Khmer phrasing. Minor differences include a slight reduction of the emotional emphasis in “ruột thịt/pit pit” and a small directional/perspectival difference in “ទៅសួរនាំ.” These do not substantially affect comprehension or cultural appropriateness. per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Quan điểm của người Khmer cũng giống như người Kinh "bà con xa không bằng láng giềng gần", nên dù chưa thân cũng cố gắng giữ tình cảm.

linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: There are no complex interpersonal pronouns or religious honorifics in this sentence. 'អ្នកគិញ' for 'người Kinh' is understandable, though less formal than an ethnonym phrase such as 'ជនជាតិគិញ' or the reference's 'ជនជាតិយួន'. Some phrasing is slightly awkward: 'ក៏ដូចអ្នកគិញថា' would be smoother with a fuller construction, and 'អ្នកជិតខាងជិត' is somewhat redundant because 'អ្នកជិតខាង' already implies neighbor. Still, the word order and clause linkage are understandable and broadly Khmer-like.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a good translation. It accurately conveys the proverb and the social message of maintaining goodwill despite lack of closeness. Its main weaknesses are stylistic and lexical-formality issues: 'អ្នកគិញ' is understandable but less culturally/regionally aligned with the reference, 'អ្នកជិតខាងជិត' is redundant, and 'រក្សាទឹកចិត្តគ្នា' is slightly less precise than maintaining relationships. per_sample.text: Phỏng vấn viên: Trong trường hợp có việc lớn như cưới hỏi, ma chay, người Khmer có giúp nhau không?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core proposition: the interviewer asks whether Khmer people help one another when there are major occasions such as weddings and funerals. linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The hypothesis uses “ខ្មែរយើង” instead of the more neutral “ជនជាតិខ្មែរ.” This adds an inclusive/community-oriented nuance, roughly “we Khmer/our Khmer people.” In Khmer Krom or in-community discourse this can be pragmatically natural and should not be treated as an error by itself. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatically understandable and flows naturally in a colloquial spoken Khmer style: “បើមានការធំៗ... នោះ...មានជួយគ្នាអត់?” Word order is acceptable. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: The translation hypothesis is a good, colloquial rendering of the source. Minor issues include the less standard or narrower “ការកូន” for “cưới hỏi/រៀបការ,” the slightly redundant interviewer label, and the added inclusive nuance in “ខ្មែរយើង.” These do not make the translation unacceptable, and there are no false transliterations or major semantic distortions.

per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Có chứ chị. Ai trong xóm có đám tiệc, cả làng đến phụ dọn, nấu ăn, bưng bê mà không cần mời gọi nhiều.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ៖ មានតើបងស្រី។ អ្នកណាក្នុងភូមិមានពិធីបុណ្យទាន ពិធីជប់លៀង គឺអ្នកភូមិទាំងមូលមកជួយរៀបចំ ស្លរម្ហូប ដោយមិនបាច់ហៅច្រើននោះទេ។

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content very well: the Khmer respondent affirms, addresses the older sister, explains that when anyone in the village has a ceremony/party, the whole village comes to help prepare, cook, carry/serve, and that extensive invitation is unnecessary. 'បុណ្យមានការ' is a culturally valid regional/social expression rather than a mistransliteration.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The syntax is natural and fluent. The sequence 'អ្នកណាក្នុងភូមិមានបុណ្យមានការ អ្នកភូមិទាំងមូលមកជួយ...' is understandable and idiomatic, though adding a connector such as 'គឺ' or 'ដោយ' would make it slightly closer to the reference. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: Overall, the hypothesis is a high-quality translation that accurately conveys the source meaning, maintains Khmer kinship pragmatics, uses authentic vocabulary, and flows naturally. per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Dù nhà mình nghèo, nhưng khi hàng xóm có chuyện buồn, cũng sẽ đem theo nắm gạo, bó rau đến chia sẻ chút tình nghĩa.

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core proposition very well: Khmer people/Khmer community members, despite poverty, bring rice and vegetables to neighbors in times of sadness or misfortune to share goodwill. It even retains source details that the human reference generalizes, such as 'អង្ករមួយក្តាប់' for 'nắm gạo' and 'បន្លែមួយចង' for 'bó rau'. 'មានរឿងទុក្ខ' accurately conveys 'có chuyện buồn'. 'ចែករំលែកទឹកចិត្តបន្តិចបន្តួច' is a faithful rendering of sharing a small amount of affection/goodwill. Minor difference: the reference uses a first-person framing with 'គ្រួសារខ្ញុំ/ខ្ញុំ', while the hypothesis uses a more generic/reflexive framing, but this remains compatible with the source’s broad cultural statement.

linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: No fake phonetic transliterations or corrupted character-copying are present. All lexical choices are legitimate Khmer: 'អង្ករមួយក្តាប់', 'បន្លែមួយចង', 'រឿងទុក្ខ', 'ទឹកចិត្ត', and 'បន្តិចបន្តួច' are authentic and contextually appropriate. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence flows naturally overall. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that preserves the cultural and semantic content of the source and in some respects is more detailed than the human reference. It accurately captures neighborly solidarity among Khmer people and uses legitimate Khmer vocabulary without false transliteration. Minor issues involve the less formal 'អ្នកខ្មែរ' compared with 'ជនជាតិខ្មែរ', the use of 'ផ្ទះខ្លួន' instead of a clearer household/family expression, and slightly compressed syntax, but these do not seriously impair meaning or cultural appropriateness.

linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that faithfully conveys the source and aligns closely with the human reference. per_sample.text: Phỏng vấn viên: Có khi nào xảy ra mâu thuẫn hay xích mích giữa hàng xóm không anh?

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core informational content of the source and reference: the interviewer asks whether conflicts or disputes ever occur between neighbors. The rendering of “mâu thuẫn hay xích mích” as “ទំនាស់ ឬទាស់ទែងគ្នា” is semantically accurate. “រវាងអ្នកជិតខាង” correctly captures “between neighbors.” The phrase “មានពេលណា...” is slightly less idiomatic than the reference’s “តើធ្លាប់មាន...ទេ,” but the intended yes/no meaning remains recoverable and essentially faithful.
linguistic_analysis.step_2_subject_and_pronoun_appropriatene: The speaker label “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍” is correct. Its placement at the end of the question is natural in Khmer conversational style. No inappropriate pronoun leveling or honorific mismatch is present.
linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items appear legitimate Khmer: “អ្នកសម្ភាសន៍,” “មានពេលណា,” “កើតមាន,” “ទំនាស់,” “ទាស់ទែងគ្នា,” “រវាង,” “អ្នកជិតខាង,” “អត់,” and “បង.” There is no evidence of fake phonetic transliteration or raw Vietnamese character-copying. The colloquial yes/no particle “អត់” is acceptable in spoken Khmer and fits the interview style.
linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is generally understandable and structurally acceptable. However, “មានពេលណាកើតមាន...” is somewhat less smooth than the reference’s more idiomatic “តើធ្លាប់មាន...ទេ.” A more natural construction would include “ធ្លាប់” or a clearer relative/linking structure. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately transfers the meaning, uses an appropriate Khmer address term for “anh,” and contains authentic vocabulary without problematic transliteration. per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Dạ cũng có lúc bất đồng, nhưng người Khmer hay chọn cách im lặng, nhờ người lớn khuyên bảo rồi làm hòa nhẹ nhàng.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ៖ បាទ ក៏មានពេលខ្លះមិនចុះសម្រុងគ្នាដែរបង ប៉ុន្តែជនជាតិខ្មែរច្រើនតែជ្រើសរើសវិធីស្ងាត់ស្ងៀម ឲ្យអ្នកធំជួយប្រដៅ រួចហើយក៏ផ្សះផ្សា។

Word order is coherent, with clear sequencing: disagreement occurs, Khmer people choose silence, rely on elders for advice, and then reconcile. The structure “រួចធ្វើឲ្យត្រូវគ្នាវិញស្រួលៗ” is colloquial but grammatical and understandable. Overall morpho-syntactic flow is strong and idiomatic.
linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that accurately transfers the informational content and uses natural Khmer phrasing. It respects the Khmer/KKhmer Krom sociocultural context through appropriate references to elders and communal behavior. Minor differences from the human reference include the omission of “បង,” the use of “ចា៎” instead of “បាទ,” and a somewhat more colloquial rendering of reconciliation. per_sample.text: Người Khmer: có những xóm nhỏ, khi chủ nhà đi đâu khoảng 30 phút đổ lại thì có thể “gửi nhà” cho hàng xóm, ví dụ như là “Chị đi chợ một chút, em coi nhà dùm chị nha”, vì đôi lúc khi mình đi ra ngoài có thể là sẽ có ai đó đến chơi.

linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a high-quality translation that closely matches the human reference in meaning, pragmatics, lexical choice, and syntax. per_sample.text: Người Khmer: Nhiều người ở xóm tôi không cùng họ hàng nhưng cưới hỏi, đi đám giỗ đều coi nhau như anh em một nhà.
label: ជនជាតិខ្មែរ៖ មនុស្សជាច្រើននៅក្នុងភូមិខ្ញុំមិនមែនជាបងប្អូនជីទួតមួយនឹងគ្នាទេ ប៉ុន្តែនៅពេលរៀបការ ឬទៅចូលរួមពិធីបុណ្យគម្រប់ខួប ចាត់ទុកគ្នាដូចជាបងប្អូនបង្កើតអ៊ីចឹង។

linguistic_analysis.step_1_semantic_equivalence_and_fidelity: The hypothesis preserves the core proposition well: many Khmer people in the speaker's village/hamlet are not related by blood, yet they treat one another like family when attending weddings or anniversary rites. The rendering of 'មិនមែនជាញាតិគ្នាទេ' is semantically close to 'không cùng họ hàng,' though slightly more general than the reference's stronger kinship phrasing. The phrase 'រាប់អានគ្នាដូចបងប្អូនផ្ទះតែមួយ' accurately captures the idea of treating one another like siblings in one household.

linguistic_analysis.step_3_transliteration_and_lexical_legit: All lexical items appear to be legitimate Khmer vocabulary. There are no fake phonetic transliterations from Vietnamese. linguistic_analysis.step_4_morpho_syntactic_flow: The sentence is grammatical and flows naturally overall. The structure follows Khmer discourse order well: topic label, subject group, negated kinship relation, contrastive clause, event conditions, and evaluative comparison. linguistic_analysis.holistic_justification: This is a strong translation with the main meaning preserved and culturally appropriate Khmer vocabulary. per_sample.text: Phỏng vấn viên: Nếu trong xóm có người gặp khó khăn kinh tế, người Khmer thường làm gì?
